contract.title: R03 final adversarial evidence-gate review
contract.goal: Act as a hostile but evidence-bounded reviewer. Try to make malformed, incomplete or mismatched evidence produce PRESSURE_CANDIDATE or NO_PRESSURE_PHYS_VALID. Investigate disjoint-time utilization and queueing; queue wait on the wrong directed link or wrong packet/service window; denominator-only saturation; ineligible windows; unmatched entries; events beyond stop time; missing counters; undeclared arms; unverified or tampered persisted analysis; altered decision contract; simultaneous RUNBOOK plus compile-report hash forgery; physical or drain invalidity; candidate-only onset; and unlocalized ISL_QUEUE_OVERFLOW. Check classifier ordering, exact cohort identity, threshold synchronization, deterministic RUNBOOK re-rendering and the boundary between internal direct-dict unit tests and the formal persisted CLI. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES. Do not edit files. Never emit example or placeholder evidence: every evidence item must use the exact github://fuguther/leo-direct-sim/blob/95d28051696ccaa6e75a46bb552e60874f5da256/<allowed-path>#Lx-Ly form; omit a finding if you cannot supply that form.
acceptance: Verify the exact commit and declared artifact set.
Try every declared malformed, disjoint-time, wrong-link, incomplete-drain and unlocalized-overflow bypass.
Verify the five ordered classes and every fail-loud non-classification path are mutually intelligible.
Verify the formal persisted CLI cannot accept tampered or unverified V2 analysis.
Verify changing the decision contract or jointly forging RUNBOOK and compile-report hashes is rejected.
Verify direct in-memory classification remains a unit-test/internal function and is not the formal evidence path.
Verify no post-hoc threshold, extra arm, 1 MHz run or algorithm comparison is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Line-grounded exact-commit evidence with no placeholders
At least one mechanism counterexample or covered regression
Explicit open_items and PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES
